_meta.hardware: RTX 5090 32 GB (shared), 16 CPU cores, 58 GB RAM, WSL2; HF caches populated
_meta.smoke_s: wall-clock per stage from `run_all.py --smoke --force` (includes interpreter start-up)
_meta.measured_s: sum of the timed blocks of one run on `measured_units` at full settings (see scripts/outputs/data_0N_*/timing*/timings.jsonl)
_meta.extrapolated_full_s: linear scaling of the per-unit blocks to `total_units` plus the fixed blocks

01_coordinate.measured_units: 1024 studies (ALE smoothing + DiFuMo projection), 20 figure pairs, --n-jobs 16
01_coordinate.notes: ALE 8.7*30826/1024=262 s; projection 2.5*30.1=75 s (upper bound, includes P build); fixed difumo_fit+figures+load=26 s; plus ~60 s to write two 3.5 GB tensors. Notebook: single-core nimare (hours) and the whole 3.5 GB matrix on the GPU.

02_pubmed.notes: encode 0.7*30826/512=42 s + 2.2 s fixed. Notebook: batch 16 fp32, no length sorting.

03_neurovault.measured_units: 100 candidate images (first 100 rows after the notebook's metadata filters), 16 workers; 53 maps / 6 publications survived
03_neurovault.notes: resample 3.7*46.1=171 s; cluster 3.5*46.1=161 s (linear; each block includes ~2 s pool start-up so this is an upper bound); fixed ~8 s; SPECTER on 312 publications x3 passes ~2 s. All 4611 .nii.gz files are present locally; full set = 3183 maps / 312 publications.

04_neurowiki.notes: optional stage; encode 0.6*38410/512=45 s + fixed. Projection heads are negligible.

05_cogatlas.measured_units: full: 295 terms (top-300 graph nodes with a definition)

06_n_grams.measured_units: full: 30826 documents -> 8737 n-grams (count>=100) -> 3152 terms (default, no manual filter)
06_n_grams.notes: measured in full; count_vectorize is single-core sklearn. With --corpus ~/.cache/neurovlm/ngram_labels.npy the notebook artifact is reproduced (2458 identical labels, 99.83% identical matrix cells); --whitelist release yields 1295 terms.

07_transform_text_llm.measured_units: 128 abstracts x 256 max new tokens, Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B-Base bf16, batch 16, plain prompt (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct weights not available locally)
07_transform_text_llm.measured_throughput: 332 new tokens/s; 21196 new tokens for 128 summaries (~166 per summary, EOS-terminated)
07_transform_text_llm.notes: 15400 s (4.3 h) is for the 0.6B model actually measured. Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct NOT measured: decode is weight-bandwidth-bound, so per-step cost ~13x (16 GB vs 1.2 GB) -> ~55 h at the notebook's batch 16; batch 48-64 fits 32 GB and should give ~15-20 h.
